title: SanctumSack
description: Personal sanctuaries bound to each player, accessible through an immersive sack-and-anchor system.
body:
## 🧿 SanctumSack

**SanctumSack** adds personal, persistent sanctuaries for each player —  
a private refuge accessed through a physical **sack + anchor** ritual.

Every player can bind a **Sanctum Sack** to an anchor (**Barrel or Decorated Pot**) and access their own floating sanctuary:  
a peaceful, mob-free space that is always the same, always theirs.

---

## ✨ Core Features

### 🎒 Sanctum Sack
- Craftable ritual item
  ![Minecraft crafting recipe for the Sanctum Sack. The recipe uses string, leather, an ender pearl, and a barrel arranged in a crafting table, resulting in a Sanctum Sack item used to create a personal sanctuary.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8517e30f4d105479f6e2eb5189ab86e8ee8eee56_0.webp)
- Bound permanently to a player UUID
- Can be used from **any dimension**
- Ownership never changes

### ⚓ Anchors (Barrel / Decorated Pot)
- Physical blocks placed in the world
- Act as gateways to sanctuaries
- Ownership protected
- Breaking the anchor safely removes the link

### 🏝️ Personal Sanctuary Island
- One unique floating island per player
- Deterministic UUID-based placement
- Generated **once** — never resets
- Fully persistent (blocks remain forever)

### ⬅️ Exit Platform
- Physical pressure plate inside the sanctum
- Returns the player safely to their **original anchor**
- If no anchor exists, falls back to world spawn

---

## 🛡️ Protection & Rules

- No mobs, no weather, no raids
- No PvP
- No explosions, fire spread, or block physics
- Anti-suffocation and void rescue
- Players are softly clamped inside their sanctuary borders
- Visitors are protected and restricted

---

## 🌌 Immersion & Atmosphere

- Ambient portal and void particles
- Central altar with magical effects
- Subtle amethyst and arcane sound cues
- Entry and exit are **physical and visible**, not commands

---

## ⚙️ Technical Notes

- Designed for **Paper / Purpur 1.21.x**
- Zero external dependencies
- Custom void world generator
- Optimized UUID-based plot allocation
- No commands required
- Fully server-side

---

## 🎯 Intended Use

SanctumSack is ideal for:
- Survival servers
- Hardcore or immersive gameplay
- Roleplay environments
- Personal bases without claim plugins

> “Your refuge is not claimed.  
> It is remembered.”
